app.title: osu! Render
app.heading: Turn replays into videos
app.subtitle: Upload an .osr replay and the service finds the beatmap, queues the render and outputs an MP4.

upload.title: Upload a replay
upload.tokenPlaceholder: Leave empty if auth is disabled
upload.browse: or click to choose a file

errors.INVALID_REPLAY: This file isn't a valid .osr replay.
errors.REPLAY_TOO_LARGE: The replay exceeds the 5 MiB limit.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many uploads. Wait for your current renders to finish, then try again.
errors.QUEUE_FULL: The render queue is full. Try again later.
errors.RENDERER_UNAVAILABLE: The renderer isn't ready on the server. Try again later or check the diagnostics report.
errors.STORAGE_LOW: The server is low on disk space. Try again later.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: The service token is missing or invalid.
errors.INVALID_OPTIONS: Some render settings were rejected. Reload the page and try again.
errors.BEATMAP_NOT_FOUND: Couldn't find the beatmap for this replay.
errors.BEATMAP_DOWNLOAD_FAILED: Couldn't download the beatmap. Try again later.
errors.BEATMAP_INVALID_ARCHIVE: The downloaded beatmap archive is invalid.
errors.BEATMAP_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH: The downloaded beatmap doesn't match the replay's version.
errors.RENDER_TIMEOUT: The render took too long and was stopped.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: The server ran into an internal error.
errors.REPORT_WEBHOOK_DISABLED: Sending reports to the developer isn't set up on this server.
errors.REPORT_SEND_FAILED: Couldn't send the report to the developer. Try again later, or download it and send the file instead.
errors.SKIN_INVALID: That file isn't a usable osu! skin. Upload an .osk exported from osu! or a skin download.
errors.SKIN_TOO_LARGE: That skin is larger than this server allows.
errors.RENDER_EXPIRED: This video was deleted, either because it expired or because its files were removed.
errors.RENDER_ACTIVE: This render is still running. Cancel it before deleting its files.
errors.UPDATE_NOT_PORTABLE: In-app updates only work in the Windows portable zip started with start.bat. Update a source install with git pull.
errors.UPDATE_BUSY: A render is still running or an update is already in progress. Try again once it finishes.
errors.UPDATE_FAILED: The update couldn't be downloaded or verified. Nothing was changed. Try again later.

settings.title: Custom render settings
settings.hint: Applied to this render only; the server's base settings never change
settings.footer: FPS, video encoder and motion blur are fixed by the server to keep renders reliable.

skin.failed: Couldn't upload the skin. Check your connection and try again.
skin.hint: Uploaded skins are saved on this server and can be picked for any render.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.hint: Helps track down GPU and renderer problems
diagnostics.includes: Includes your OS, GPU model and driver, encoder self-tests, danser and ffmpeg info, and recent render results and logs, with home folder paths redacted.
diagnostics.excludes: Never includes tokens, secrets, IP addresses or player names.
diagnostics.privacy: Nothing is sent automatically. You choose whether to share it.
diagnostics.autoSend: This server sends a redacted report to the developer after every finished render.
diagnostics.loading: Collecting the report… encoder self-tests can take a while.
diagnostics.copyManual: The browser blocked the clipboard. Select the text below and copy it.
diagnostics.opened: GitHub issue opened in a new tab.
diagnostics.openAgain: Report ready. Click “Open GitHub issue” again.
diagnostics.needsToken: This server requires a service token. Enter it in step 01 and try again.
diagnostics.failed: Couldn't get the diagnostics report. Try again.
diagnostics.noIssueLink: The report doesn't include a valid GitHub issue link.
diagnostics.sending: Sending the report to the developer…
diagnostics.sent: Report sent to the developer. Thanks!

update.gitHint: To update a source install, run git pull, npm ci and npm run build, then restart osu-render.
update.confirm: Download osu-render {version} and restart? Your settings and files are kept, and this page reloads by itself.
update.downloading: Downloading and checking the update. This can take a few minutes…
update.restarting: Installing the update and restarting. This page reloads by itself.
update.notInstalled: The update wasn't installed, so you're still on {version}. Details are in data\update\apply-update.log.
update.timeout: osu-render didn't come back. Check the osu-render window, then reload this page.
